Q1: Sodium 2,4-dichlorobenzoate is broadly categorized as data deficient across all hazard classes. This includes carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, environmental, endocrine disruption, inhalation, oral, dermal, eye, organ, and systemic hazards, all of which are classified as Tier 4. Consequently, there is insufficient information to confidently assess its potential hazards.
Q2: Sodium 2,4-dichlorobenzoate is not present on any established lists of concern or low hazard. This absence, coupled with the pervasive data deficiency in its hazard profile, suggests a lack of comprehensive study rather than confirmed safety.
Q3: This chemical is poorly characterized, evidenced by a very low number of literature references (31) and no records in the EPA ToxValDB.
